title: Eight Sleep advisors
description: A black band introducing expert advisors: a mono eyebrow and a white heading that fade up, then two big pale-grey cards side by side, each with a name and a three-line role at the top-left and a black-and-white cut-out portrait rising from the bottom edge. The cards stack on phones.
notes: dark-scoped black band; the cards use the inverse of the scope (light on black)
one portrait slot per card, a cut-out about 88% wide and 72% tall, anchored to the bottom
name: eightsleep-advisors
